title: A cook prepares vegetables in Cleveland
licence: Public domain in the United States (official U.S. Navy photograph)
alt: A person in a tall white hat chops vegetables at a kitchen worktop.
provenance: Official U.S. Navy image. The caption identifies Culinary Specialist Antonio Lindsey preparing a meal at Cuyahoga Community College in Cleveland. The event date in the caption and camera metadata is 30 August 2012.
hint: Look at what the person is doing with the food.
evidence: The person is chopping vegetables at a kitchen worktop. The archive identifies the cook as Antonio Lindsey.

title: A geography lesson in Concho, Arizona
credit: Russell Lee / Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division, FSA/OWI Collection
alt: A person standing beside a blackboard points to a large wall map.
provenance: Library of Congress catalogue record 2017788007 identifies a school teacher teaching geography. Russell Lee photographed the lesson in October 1940. The archive holds the safety-film negative.
hint: Look at how the person is using the wall map.
evidence: The person is pointing to a map during a geography lesson.

title: A registered nurse takes a blood pressure reading
licence: Public domain in the United States (official U.S. Navy photograph)
alt: A person in a white shirt checks a cuff around a seated person’s upper arm.
provenance: Official U.S. Navy image. The caption identifies Project HOPE registered nurse Laura Seris checking a patient in Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago. The photograph was taken during an outreach visit to a school.
hint: Look at the cuff on the seated person’s arm.
evidence: The cuff measures blood pressure. The archive identifies the person taking the reading as a registered nurse.
